title: Gap closure by provider type
one_line_definition: Displays the distribution of closed care gaps across provider types to reveal which care settings are driving documentation and coding completeness. Answers 'Through which provider types are risk adjustment gaps being closed?'
result_meaning: [{"pattern": "Primary Care Physicians dominate with 65%+ of gap closures", "interpretation": "PCP-led outreach is highly effective, but over-reliance on one provider type creates vulnerability if PCP engagement declines."}, {"pattern": "Specialists and ancillary providers share closures nearly equally with no single type exceeding 30%", "interpretation": "Gap closure is broadly distributed, suggesting a well-coordinated multi-specialty strategy but potential inefficiency from lack of a clear accountability owner."}, {"pattern": "Telehealth or urgent care providers account for a disproportionately large slice", "interpretation": "Non-traditional care settings are capturing significant RAF opportunities, warranting investment in structured coding workflows for those channels."}]
